description: Send a keyboard key press, with optional modifiers, to an element on the page.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys held during the press

target.description: Element to receive the key; defaults to the currently focused element

nth.description: Zero-based index when several elements match

role.description: Tag name or ARIA role to narrow matches, e.g. "button" or "link"

text.description: Case-insensitive visible text the element should contain

name: page_pressKey
